name: Context Engineering and Agent Skills
outcome: Design reusable context and agent instructions for a coding workflow.
description: Control the context supplied to a coding agent through project instructions, selected files and reusable skills. Create a small skill with explicit instructions and deterministic checks, then assess its behaviour.
external: Basic programming, Git, command-line use and familiarity with project file structure.
learn: Manage context and diagnose conflicting project instructions
Create a reusable skill with a deterministic check
Evaluate skill activation, failure cases and versioned behaviour
tools: Your chosen CLI (Claude Code or Codex)
moduleDescriptions: Inspect context use, instruction precedence and irrelevant files.
Encode a repeatable research procedure in SKILL.md with scoped supporting files.
Add a deterministic check; keep untrusted data separate from instructions.
Compare activation, outputs and failures with and without the skill.
practice: Build a skill for a repeatable repository inspection or scientific validation task.
acceptance: The skill triggers for relevant tasks, avoids unrelated tasks, runs a deterministic check and has versioned instructions.
prerequisiteRationale: One CLI course supplies repository navigation and agent operation needed to create and test skills.
